# Frozen wire format of chunk store messages (WireVersion 1). Until the first release a change replaces a line in place; after it, a change needs a WireVersion bump.
# Each line is a frame's bytes in hex: version, kind, request ID, then the kind's fields, little-endian but for the chunk ID's
# 16 big-endian bytes. A write's or read reply's data travels in the message's pool buffer, never in the frame.
# PG fields everywhere: table epoch 77, pool 1, PG 17, interval 41. Chunk (2, 3, 4). Version 41.7 unless a line says otherwise.
# hello: request 1, session 9, incarnation 1,000,000.
# write, write_expect, replica_write: request 5, session 9, incarnation 1,000,000, snapshot epoch 2; bytes 100 to 299 (one
#   block of data), then bytes 4,000 to 4,199 with expect_ver 3.9 (two blocks), then the same with version 41.7.
# punch, punch_expect_absent_chunk, replica_punch: the whole chunk; one byte at 8,192 with expect_ver 0; the whole chunk at 41.7.
# ack, ack_no_space: version 41.7 with fill 123,456 blocks; NoSpace with fill 900,000.
# reply, reply_refused, reply_mismatch: version 41.7; refused at table epoch 80, interval 42; expect_ver mismatch, at 41.7.
# read, read_at: request 6, bytes 100 to 5,099; the first block at version 41.7.
# read_reply, read_reply_missing, read_reply_unfound: version 41.7 (two blocks of data); the chunk is on the missing list; unfound.
# grant: request 7, support epoch 8, raw 51,020,500, boot ID b0 01 .. 0e bf.
# heartbeat: request 8, table epoch 77, support epoch 8, raw 51,020,500, the same boot ID.
# report_empty, report: request 9; nothing, then one activation, disk 3's latency 250, and disks of log 0x0123456789abcdef
#   (fill 1,000, oldest I/O 40) and log 2 (fill 5, oldest I/O 1,500,000, failed).
# member_timeout: request 10, disk 3. probe: request 11, disk 3. probe_reply: request 11, log 0x0123456789abcdef, oldest
#   I/O 1,500,000, failed.
# peer, peer_reply: request 12; adopt interval 41; newest (2, 3, 4) at 41.7 and (2, 3, 5) at 40.1, missing (2, 3, 4) at 41.7.
